description: Namur - BeWaPP - poubelles publiques et cabines à vêtements is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Inventaire du mobilier de propreté: Les cabines à vêtements. Les données sont gérées et encodées par le service 'Propreté publique' de la Ville de Namur dans une application mise à disposition par BeWaPP. Les données sont ensuite régulièrement récupérées et intégrées dans cet OpenData. Les rues. Coverage: Namur. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are Proprete. The portal shows 82 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2026-01-25 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
